text:
zoe (PM): quick sync — customer requests per-route model pinning. three asks: API flag for pin, console UI for rollout+audit, per-route default pin. need RICE + sequencing callout before next planning. anyone object to API-first?

mike (Eng): +1 to API-first shipping. lower dev effort and lets early adopters automate. console UI is higher polish for enterprise but will slow launch.

arjun (SE): from sales: major accounts will push for UI + audit logs. they might convert to dedicated if console missing. so business risk if we only do API. :thinking_face:

lee (Design): console work is non-trivial — list + canary controls + history. rough: 2 designers 2 engs for 3 sprints to get MVP screens and flows.

emily (CS): can confirm at least 3 pilot customers asked for console flow specifically, willing to be in pilot. they need audit trail and a revert button.

mike (Eng): quick impact/effort roughs (points):
- API flag: impact medium, effort 2
- Console UI MVP: impact high for ent, effort 8
- Per-route default pinning in runtime: impact medium, effort 3

zoe (PM): propose quick RICE numbers to help sequence. use Reach as number of customers/month (est), Impact 1-10, Confidence 0-1, Effort in points.

zoe (PM): ```
RICE = Reach * Impact * Confidence / Effort
API-flag = 50 * 6 * 0.7 / 2 = 105
Console-UI = 12 * 8 * 0.8 / 8 = 9.6
Per-route default = 30 * 5 * 0.6 / 3 = 30
```

arjun (SE): that math makes sense; API-flag highest score so ship that first, but we should gate console work to committed pilot customers and start design immediately.

lee (Design): agree — start UX spikes now so engineering has designs ready when we schedule sprints. can do 1 sprint spike to reduce uncertainty (increase Confidence).

emily (CS): i'll line up pilot customers and write acceptance criteria: audit entries, canary % control, revert, change owner. will post list here by EOD. :white_check_mark:

mike (Eng): tactical note: let's make API-flag a feature flag so console can call the same endpoint later; runtime changes minimal.

deploy-bot: Created <https://redwood/issue/RISE-412|RISE-412> "api: per-route pin flag (v1)" assigned to mike.

zoe (PM): plan agreed: 1) API-flag rollout (ship in next sprint), 2) design spike for console UI (1 sprint), 3) console MVP dev for pilot customers (after spike). I'll draft a one-pager with RICE table + launch criteria. if no objections I'll add to next sprint planning. :+1:

mike (Eng): :thumbsup:

emily (CS): :thumbsup:
